findings.pr_title: S3 store: versioned-object support and multi-region reads
findings.summary: example-app now bolts on top of your existing S3 bucket and decouples scheduling from execution, so platform teams keep their cron where it is while adding durable job queues.

evidence.note: Job store claim: S3 is the store for cloud-native and multi-region deployments.

findings.pr_title: RBAC: per-user tokens scoped to enqueue/consume
findings.summary: The holder of the root token can mint per-user tokens scoped to enqueue and/or consume, enforced by the service on every request. Shipped in v0.33.0.

evidence.note: ICP audits ask 'who could enqueue or consume this job?' — per-user token scoping answers it.
